purpose: Separate A1 Spyx/Brainstate phase after v4; same learning task, host-configuration observations only; no HPO.
wall_scope: Coordinator before fresh worker launch through cold imports/compile, array verification, A1 numerical qualification, input construction/copy, full training API, complete validation, checkpoint I/O and once-only final test. No additional test grace budget.
encoding: Cast original uint8 pixels to float64, divide by255.0, flatten row-major784; repeat the same analogue current for all100ticks. No Poisson draw, augmentation or feature fit.
split: Use existing immutable data/mnist/processed train_indices.npy and validation_indices.npy. Official test images and labels are decoded only after a full-epoch selected checkpoint exists.

initial_parameters.draw_order: input-to-hidden then hidden-to-output; source-major flattened banks
initial_parameters.shared_arrays: Materialize all five seeds before fitting; archive bytes and SHA256. Engines load common arrays rather than regenerate from equal seed.

shuffle.rule: For each epoch in1..10 draw one complete permutation of the frozen55000 training indices; archive all10 permutations before fitting.
shuffle.validation_order: ascending immutable validation_indices, all5000; final batch8

numeric_profile.optimizer: float64 Adam; lr0.001, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, epsilon=1e-8, weight_decay=0
numeric_profile.batch_reduction: mean over actual batch size, including24sample final training batch; one Adam step per batch
numeric_profile.state: Explicit zero voltage per example; no carry across batches
numeric_profile.equations: canonical_lif_v1: drift/strict threshold before synaptic update; beta0.95, theta1, detached subtract reset; fast-sigmoid VJP slope5

resource_profile: JAX CPU FP64 host-config diagnostics. OMP/BLAS requested1 does not qualify a single-thread JAX worker pool. resource_qualification=false; no strict1thread performance ranking.
views_initially_implemented: Brainstate HiddenState/scan/grad/jit with explicit canonical cell
compile: Mandatory actual JIT per batch/time shape. Input and label values are runtime arguments, never first-batch constants. All compile/import/setup/input/transfer/qualification/validation/test work consumes the same total1800s.
qualification: Matching prior four-case framework dense Q0 and bound source identities are necessary but insufficient. Inside the same1800s: three actual B32/T100 Adam updates and one actual tailB24 update versus independent oracle loss/logits/initial VJP/gradients/weights/moments/counter; pure-forward B32/B8/B16 with unchanged parameters/moments/counter; B2/T100 exact-threshold/neighbors with actual compiled first-tick margin/spikes; save/reset/restore weights+Adam moments/count. Reset to common arrays and zero Adam before epoch1.
selection: Complete all55000 training samples and all5000 validation samples before an epoch is eligible. Select maximal integer validation correct count; earliest epoch wins ties. Save each improved checkpoint with hash before committing the selection record.
continue_training_rule: After each complete epoch and checkpoint bookkeeping, continue only if another epoch remains and remaining seconds exceed1.10*just_completed_epoch_wall + 1.25*2*just_completed_validation_wall +2.0. Otherwise begin final evaluation. This fixed reserve heuristic may still censor test at the hard cap.

test_policy.gate: A selected checkpoint from a fully completed epoch exists and wall budget remains; restore that checkpoint, write durable test-start marker, then decode official test bytes.
test_policy.completion: Report test accuracy/loss only after all10000 samples finish within the same1800s cap.
test_policy.cap_before_any_epoch: censored; no selected checkpoint; test labels remain sealed
test_policy.cap_during_test: test_status=censored_at_cap; retain bestvalidation/checkpoint; no partial test accuracy and no retry
test_policy.once_only_ledger: Exclusive-create evidence/a1-jax-v1-test-once/{engine}-jit-seed-{seed}.json before decoding test labels. Engine/seed is unique even if a later contract hash changes; contract hash is recorded in ledger content. Existing A1v4 ledgers are never read as permission to test or overwritten.

failure_policy: Keep unsupported, unqualified, dependency failure, budget_rejected, timeout, divergence and incomplete test as separate outcomes; preserve all five formal seeds and original sample/epoch denominators. No truncated epoch, shorterT, smaller global batch or extra cap after results.
freeze_basis: Static separate-phase draft prepared under existing user authorization. Coordinator review/freeze precedes any model execution. --allow-run is an accidental-execution guard, not a new user-approval request. Independent v4 closed-full-audit fixture receipt and queue-frozen Q0 report/raw identities are mandatory before a new frozen contract can be created; draft cannot execute.
qualification_engine_binding: Prior Q0 engine exactly matches spyx or brainx_state, all four cases/checks pass, actual raw input/parameter dtype float64 and JAX x64=true; all Q0 identities still match. Actual framework and JAX package versions also must match the prior Q0 raw evidence.
supervision: Track own descendants by PID+creation time, including independent sessions; clean tracked remnants also after normal worker exit; Popen.wait exclusively reaps direct worker, preserving signal exit code.
revision_reason: Add genuine Spyx and Brainstate as two new formal A1 views with shared actual v4 arrays and same strict selection/test/cap policy; keep JAX resource-unqualified for strict1thread comparisons.

evaluation_forward_policy.implementation: Pure framework forward compiled separately from gradient/Adam function; no autodiff transform or optimizer update in validation/test.
evaluation_forward_policy.neuron_semantics: Same strict >0 threshold, synchronous drift-before-synaptic-update equations and per-example zero voltage as training.
evaluation_forward_policy.synchronization: jax.block_until_ready on the entire actual returned train/evaluate tuple before timing/host conversion.

boundary_qualification.scope: Qualification-only B2 full width and T100 explicit initial voltage; ordinary training/validation/test remain zero state.
boundary_qualification.expected: Negative/zero/positive representable FP64 drift-minus-threshold margins in hidden and output cells.
boundary_qualification.observed: Actual compiled framework forward returns first-tick margin and spike arrays; require exact zero at intended zero cells, correct neighbor signs, strict >0 spikes and independent oracle loss/logits/spikes.
boundary_qualification.failure: Missing actual zero margin or any mismatch is unqualified; no assumption that JIT rounding automatically preserves the boundary.

base_a1_reference.policy: Preserve v3/v4 bytes and all existing test ledgers; no re-run or HPO of another framework view.

shared_reference.policy: Read existing actual archived arrays/epoch permutations and verify their manifest/file digests; this phase cannot regenerate or choose another seed/order.
shared_reference.pending_reason: v4 shared arrays are not yet prepared; independent closed full-audit receipt must seal actual manifest and all five files before any JAX model execution

framework_scope.spyx: Actual spyx.nn.LIF(beta=1) and actual spyx.axn.superspike(k=5), explicit drift before cell, zero-forward derivative correction detaches reset.
framework_scope.brainx_state: Actual brainstate.HiddenState plus transform.scan/grad/jit. Cell equations are explicitly supplied canonical LIF; no claim to a BrainPy native neuron class.
framework_scope.no_fallback: Import/transform/qualification failure is retained as failure. Never replace a requested framework with plain JAX.

bound_interpreter: environment/jax/bin/python; sys.prefix must resolve to this exact environment
run_once_policy: Before any framework execution, the new serial queue exclusively claims each engine/seed, binds its exact output/contract/freeze and the worker exclusively records its first entry. Fresh output paths or changed contract hashes cannot rerun an engine/seed; original v4 ledgers remain untouched.
